intro: A Worker asks for a Carrier. What the Carrier may touch is decided before it starts.

steps.caption: A request to start a Carrier arrives with the parent's whole environment: every open descriptor, the whole filesystem.
Refused: carrier-confinement-unacceptable. A Carrier that inherits everything can do everything, and nothing about the grant was checked.
steps.takeaway: Ambient authority at the OS boundary: one capability needed, the whole environment handed over.

steps.caption: A ruleset arrives: the read-only and writable directories the Worker's grant names, and a descriptor seal — CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC, never a blind close.
Started, confined: exactly the filesystem and descriptor authority the grant names, sealed before the payload runs.
steps.takeaway: The descriptor seal is CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC; a blind close leaves a dup'd master in the census.

actions.note: Carrier started · confined · ABI 10 on this host

steps.caption: The witness lives in super/, a lane this book references and never copies. STATED here; measured there.
steps.takeaway: A same-UID battery measures yama, not Landlock, unless it carries a bare control — the floor is only as good as its control arm.
